scope: Isolated actual main/telemetry fixture + Go dashboard; hardware-on adds real sensor bridge. No worker, UI, game, or whole-host controlled comparison.
cpu_accounting: Sum of sampled process CPU time. Average and peak relative to one core; machine average divides by 24 logical processors. Startup included in whole-window figures; CPU counter quantization applies.
network_accounting: GET+SSE response payload UTF-8 bytes only; excludes heartbeat uploads, HTTP/TLS/Tailscale headers and NIC traffic. Viewer GET every 500 ms is a diagnostic load.
steady_window: Initial 68s run: 10..63.5s; 128s follow-up: 10..123.5s. Roles in the running follow-up confirmed against PID/executable paths; sampler label expression corrected for future runs.
